def read_dirs(path, folder):
    """
    Fetches name of all files in path in long form, and labels associated by extrapolation of directory names. 
    """
    files = os.listdir(path)
    dirs = [f for f in files if os.path.isdir(os.path.join(path, f))]
    dirs = [f for f in dirs if f.startswith(folder)]
    dirs = [f for f in dirs if f != folder]
    dirs = [f for f in dirs if f != '__pycache__']
    return dirs
